thread:
karen: Following today's all-hands — opening this thread for infra/capacity follow-ups re: GPUs, regions, and autoscale. I'll tag ops for answers.

devops: Quick snapshot: ~9,600 live GPUs globally. We27re projecting ~+15% by September. EU cluster-3 adds ~1.2k GPUs in August, APAC pilot will be smaller initially (~400 GPUs).

liam: Any change to the buffer policy? We saw some throttling last month on hosted queues.

devops: Buffer policy increased to 12% capacity margin for hosted pools to reduce throttles. Dedicated/reserved pools are unchanged.

anya: APAC pilot question: can we enforce strict locality so traffic from SG/JP stays in-region? Customers care about data residency.

devops: Yes. Control-plane flag region_affinity: strict prevents cross-region routing for Private and dedicated deployments. Hosted customers can opt-in via Project settings.

liam: Autoscale specifics: will v2 pre-warm workers or just spin on demand? Cold starts were a pain for latency-sensitive apps.

agnes: hybrid-autoscaler v2 supports pre-warm pools and node pre-init hooks for model cache warming. Canary next week includes KV-cache reuse to reduce token-latency on warmup.

sam-sales: How do we bill pre-warm capacity? Customers are asking if they27ll see charges for standing warm nodes.

finance: Pre-warm is billed as reserved-seconds. Console will surface a "pre-warm reservation" line item and the billing export will include it per-project.

agnes: Example autoscaler policy (MVP):
```
autoscaler:
  strategy: hybrid
  prewarm:
    enabled: true
    nodes: 2
    duration_s: 300
  burst_pool:
    size_gpus: 6
    policy: queue-depth
```

sam-sales: Will pre-warm/burst be on by default for hosted customers?

agnes: Default: pre-warm enabled for hosted tiers to protect latency; burst_pool is enabled but bounded. Dedicated/reserved accounts can opt-out or set limits.

ops-bot: Scheduled: hybrid-autoscaler-canary deploy at 2026-07-07T01:00Z (1h window). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hybrid-autoscaler-canary

karen: Action items: ops to post the canary telemetry (latency delta, cold-start times) in this thread after canary, docs to prepare a 1-pager for sales, and product to publish an FAQ on region_affinity and billing.

liam: +1 to the one-pager. also request a demo session with a customer next week.

devops: Created channel #apac-readiness for region onboarding and vendor ETAs.

karen: Thanks all 28feel free to drop short follow-ups here29 :pray:
